setup.title: Set up Familiar
setup.sub: Three short steps: your game, the addon, and who answers your questions.
setup.startsLater: Familiar starts when you finish or skip this.
setup.game.heading: Where is WoW Forever?
setup.game.text: Familiar looked for it on this PC. Pick the client it should use, or choose its folder.
setup.game.pick: Pick a client to go on.
setup.addon.heading: The addon
setup.addon.text: The addon adds Familiar's chat window to the game. It goes into the client you chose.
setup.addon.current: The addon is already up to date.
setup.addon.reload: WoW is running: type /reload in game to load the update.
setup.addon.restartWow: WoW is running: quit WoW completely and start it again; /reload does not find new files.
setup.addon.startWow: The addon loads when you start WoW Forever.
setup.brain.heading: Who should answer?
setup.brain.text: Pick a kind of brain. The Brain page opens on it, where you set it up and test it. You can change it at any time.
setup.con.noWebSearch: No web search in this version
setup.chatgpt.pro.cost: No extra cost with a Plus or Pro plan
setup.chatgpt.con.signIn: Needs a sign-in in the browser
setup.agent.pro.tools: Your agent's own tools and memory
setup.agent.pro.web: Web search, if your agent has it
setup.later.agent: For now, Familiar answers with your own agent ({command}). That needs the agent installed on this PC.
setup.later.ssh: For now, Familiar answers with your own agent on {host}.
setup.later.same: For now, Familiar answers with the brain in your settings.
